Based on your history of decreased bowel sounds, abdominal distension, and failure to pass gas or stool, I am highly concerned about an ileus or bowel obstruction. Given the postpartum uterine tenderness and fever, could you describe the exact location of your most severe pain and whether it radiates to your shoulder? speaker: Doctor

To further evaluate your decreased bowel sounds and abdominal distension, have you noticed any specific type of abdominal pain, such as severe cramping, or do you have any history of recent abdominal surgeries? speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Ileus.

The normal lactate and lipase levels effectively rule out acute pancreatitis and bowel ischemia, which are critical differentials for your abdominal distension and lack of bowel sounds. Given the history of a prolonged labor and uterine tenderness, the clinical picture strongly points towards a functional ileus rather than a mechanical obstruction or inflammatory process. I will be monitoring your response to conservative management, which includes bowel rest and nasogastric decompression if symptoms persist.
